newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest grain dealers post corn, soy protection.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest grain dealers post corn, soy protection.

text.p: U.S. Midwest cash grain dealers said Monday there was widespread five to 10 cents per bushel protection on soybeans and one to three cents a bushel on corn ahead of expected lower futures openings.
Some others were relying on lower overnight Project A prices as the basis for their bids. CBOT March soybeans were 7-1/2 cents lower overnight and March corn 2-1/4 cents down.
Movement was light in most areas although fairly active producer selling of corn and soybeans was reported in part of Iowa and Illinois.
